20079.summary:
End the world in a unique skill based physics puzzle! King Oddball swings a boulder back and forth by its tongue. Release the boulder by tapping the screen. Time the release accurately to crush as many targets as possible with each boulder.

Extra boulders are awarded when crushing three or more targets with a single boulder. Anticipate how boulders roll and bounce. Use explosive crates to wreak havoc on the puny humans. Take advantage of collapsing structures too!

Conquer the world by defeating the humans in more than 120 fun and increasingly challenging levels!

26879.summary: Become a werewolf, known as Garou, in the atmosphere of their shamanistic and tribal world. Garou are Werewolf warriors opposed to urban civilization and supernatural corruption, all heading towards inevitable apocalypse. Werewolf: The Apocalypse is set in the World of Darkness, a gritty version of our own time where society declines and humans fall victim to supernatural horrors.

68979.summary:
A full-scale Strategy RPG shown at an isometric view!
Your aim is to change the course of history.
Utilize a number of different classes and skills to crush your enemies!

Story
Ixtona's long fight has finally come to an end.

Many believed that the leadership of the wise king Lefante would pave the way for an era of peace for Prince Kyle and the people of Ixtona, but now...

Kyle, the compassionate young prince caught up in plots and conspiracies that have thrown him head-first into a battle that will ultimately decide the fate of his kingdom.

The one who waits beyond your battles with powerful adversaries...
And the future that you and your allies so dearly desire...

Character Creation
The main character and hired character's
・Face graphics
・Battle voice
・Class
can all be assigned and/or changed by the player.

Strategy
Powerful melee and ranged attacks, restorative and destructive magic...
Players can use their skills to the best of their abilities to execute strategies and achieve victory.

Village Expansion
Players can invest in the village that will serve as their base to research and develop new weapons and armor.

Create powerful weapons that will give you an edge in battle.

Class/Ability System
Increasing your class level will allow you to take on higher-level classes.
Equip up to three Abilities onto each character to ensure that you're sending your strongest possible party into the field.

Special Moves/Combo Attacks
Save up SP to unleash a character's Special Move or pair them with another character to unleash a Combo Attack.

A splendid cut-in will mark the beginning of the end for your enemies.

98379.summary:
Krumit's Tale, the second game in the Meteorfall universe, is a brand new take on the deckbuilding roguelike genre. Dungeons are laid out in a 3x3 grid, and you'll need to use your items wisely to survive. You'll build your deck and earn perks as you fight your way to the Uberlich. Do you have what it takes to defeat the Uberlich?

Battle the likes of sozzled bearbearians and nuke-addled snotwolves to protect our glowing green world from the sweaty hands of the Uberlich! Krumit's Tale involves the same core deck building mechanics as Meteorfall: Journeys and the same cast of overly optimistic heroes, but expands the ‘swipe’ mechanic into a dynamic grid based system. This means more depth and longevity – our heroes will have to choose perks to complement their deck-building strategy and carefully manage the board if they wish to triumph.

110779.summary: Join Kotone in this Visual Novel on her adventure as Viola in her online game Asaph Online. Find friends, accept their quests and get to know the world of Asaph.

132579.summary: Police Shootout is a new turn-based FPS game. Put on your uniform and get ready to respond the most surprising calls in your policeman’s career. Solve cases and gain experience, but also find out why a good young policeman gave up his career in a big city and moved to a small town of San Adrino.
132579.storyline: Police Shootout is a new turn-based FPS game. Put on your uniform and get ready to respond the most surprising calls in your policeman’s career. Solve cases and gain experience, but also find out why a good young policeman gave up his career in a big city and moved to a small town of San Adrino.

134579.summary: Foreclosed is a Cyberpunk action-shooter set in a comic book world. Follow the events of Evan Kapnos in this original comic book styled game and discover how losing your identity is all too possible.

136879.summary: Black Myth: Wukong is an action role-playing game developed by Game Science, inspired by the classical Chinese novel Journey to the West. Players control the Destined One, a staff-wielding monkey protagonist, through mostly linear levels interspersed with expansive areas. The game features Soulslike elements, a flexible skill system, and boss encounters of varying intensity. It was the first installment in the Black Myth series and is widely regarded as the first AAA game from the Chinese video game industry.
136879.storyline:
Following his legendary pilgrimage to the West alongside the Tang Monk, Sun Wukong ascends to Buddhahood but rejects the Celestial Court in favor of his simple life on Mount Huaguo. The Court, grown mistrustful, sends an army led by Erlang Shen to force his submission. During their duel, the binding circlet incapacitates Wukong, and he is sealed in stone, severed from six powerful relics corresponding to his senses. Over the following centuries, the monkeys of the mountain seek to recover these relics and revive their fallen king.

The Destined One, one of these monkeys, sets out on a journey across treacherous lands to reclaim the relics. From the fog-shrouded Black Wind Mountain to the barren Yellow Wind Ridge, the frozen peaks of The New West, and the fiery slopes of the Flaming Mountains, the path forward is guarded by powerful yaoguai and ancient figures from Chinese mythology. Old allies of Wukong, including the wayward Zhu Bajie, join the quest as the truth of the Destined One's connection to Sun Wukong slowly comes into focus.

139679.summary: 41 Hours is a first-person shooter dramatic game that follows the narrative of Ethan, a workaholic scientist in search of his long-lost wife. The story is intriguing and it takes several surprising turns as it develops over 11 Chapters and 20 hours of gameplay.

141079.summary:
Boss Rush: Mythology - This is an action game in which you have to fight various creatures and gods from Greek, Scandinavian, Slavic and Egyptian mythologies.

Take on the role of a mysterious knight who travels across different worlds in search of the most difficult opponents.

Game features:
- Souls-like style combat system
- 20 bosses
- 6 types of weapons and 6 types of items to choose from

141479.summary:
Genesis is a Next Gen free to play MOBA developed with Unreal 4 Engine. It features 5v5 competitive gameplay, story campaign and other game modes. The game boasts of smooth gameplay and stunning graphics, coupled with its intuitive joystick control, Genesis is an innovative MOBA tailored for console gamers.
It's available on playstation network and is compatible with playstation 4 and playstation 5 consoles.
141479.storyline: The year is 2332, and the Universe is dying. Expanding far faster than previously imagined, the very fabric of space-time has begun to split at the seams, and in a few short centuries the entire universe will be torn apart in one final, all-encompassing explosion. This terrible revelation was first discovered by scientists at the ZPT Corporation—the largest, wealthiest, and most cutthroat commercial entity in existence—and soon made known to all of the universe's races. The Human Federation, despite being a relatively new player on the interstellar stage, spearheaded the search for a way out. Hidden away in the perilous dark matter labyrinths of the Eridanus Supervoid, human explorers located an artifact left behind from the Big Bang: a primordial space-time rip which could be used as a gateway out of the Universe. Where exactly this gateway led, none could say, but it offered an escape from certain death.

145079.summary: A thoughtful and deeply personal narrative-title with stripped-down mechanics. The lack of dialogue or text allows you to fully immerse yourself in the chapters of four characters, each with their joys and heartache. Contains over 20 original, beautifully-sung songs.
145079.storyline: Play through four chapters that capture the essence of everyday life and skip through the snapshots of moments both meaningful and mundane — All set to a nostalgic soundtrack. No dialogue or text means that you can share moments of time with the characters and create your interpretations. Though the experience is short (under 3 hours) The Longest Road on Earth allows you to wrap yourself like a cozy blanket in the beauty of small joys like blowing dandelion seeds, collecting seashells, sledding on the first day of winter, and riding a bike on a summer day.

150979.summary: Feel the excitement of the 90s with the isometric perspective, its huge number of vehicles and its brilliant soundtrack. More than 60 cars from six manufacturers from different countries to buy, an extensive campaign mode, dozens of circuits, rally stages, championships, and much more awaits you!

157379.summary: This story is about a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven roguelike with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

161379.summary: You've come to help your Granny after a terrible storm destroyed her cottage and wreaked havoc in her idyllic coastal town. Can you find a way of restoring her home and uniting the townsfolk? Connect with nature by foraging, gardening, and cooking, then try out your new skills in the real world!
161379.storyline: You arrive at Wholesome, a small coastal village, just after a terrible storm has destroyed your Granny’s cottage and wreaked havoc in town. Can you find a way of restoring her home and helping the townsfolk? Connect with nature as you forage for wild food, tend to your garden, and cook delicious recipes. As you help repair the town, you’ll end up forming friendships with its residents, who are slowly coming together as a community striving for sustainability.

169679.summary: Suhoshin is a 2D Visual Novel taking place during medieval Korea. While investigating mysterious murders, you will have to make interactive choices that will lead you to different paths and endings.

175679.summary: Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, Loretta, a girl who has parasitized by an alien beast, tries to break through the fog and uncover the truth about her fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest place?
175679.storyline:
Bionic girl Tania is assigned by her creator, Dr. Herveus to search and rescue a missing Investigation Force in the rainforest of Horace Islands where mysterious Karpas energy turns local animals and plants into aggressive mutants called “anathemorphs”.

After defeating the large mutant creature that attacked the Investigation Force, Tania discovers the centuries-old remains of the Eternity civilization deep in the rainforest and then finds the source of the abnormal energy at the site of the legendary Altar of the Eternity.

Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will embark on an adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in this darkest and desperate place though?

187479.summary: Enjoy 12 games in one with the perfect reproduction of real pinball machines, with all kinds of graphic details and sounds. Discover all the secrets, in these thrilling games, a great challenge awaits you. Complete all the missions and become number 1 in the world or the best among your Friends, posting your high score on the online leaderboard.

192079.summary: Plumber Hero is an exciting way to test your creativity. There are 3 main stages, 40 levels each, so there's no shortage of content for you to enjoy. Each one gets increasingly difficult, so you have to use all your skills and work hard to pass them all.

192279.summary: Compete with Pretty Girls in the puzzle game "Rivers"!Find and eliminate the paired tiles within the time limit.You can get various costumes of beautiful girls by clearing each stage.Aim, complete the costume!

192479.summary: Dreamers will lead you on an emotional journey in a story about friendship, exploration, and personal growth. Join the three characters in their adventure through a 3D world with secondary storylines and mini-games, vehicles to upgrade, puzzles to solve, and collaborative split-screen experiences.

194979.summary: A violent storm has hit the area near Martinshof. Mount up and see what damage the storm has done. Ride across the fields, jump over numerous obstacles and have Bibi the witch magic away the mess. But most of all, you can have lots of fun in fast-paced horse races, show off your jumping and slalom riding skills, take loving care of the horses and send photos to your worried friend Naomi in Australia.

195679.summary: Embark in a journey to rescue your dog in Frogue. A bullet-hell time manipulation roguelike platformer.

200679.summary: Are you tired of the same boring old vacations? Then boy have we got the tonic for you! Slaycation Paradise offers the ultimate in multi-dimensional apocalyptic tours. Slay away your worries with Twin-Stick action mixed with Tower Defence as you visit the end-of-world scenarios of your dreams!

203679.summary: Help the kitten rescue his human and other kittens from a spaceship controlled by an alien AI (artificial intelligence).

206679.summary: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

207479.summary: “Once Again” is an interactive story game about a boy who spends his summers wandering between past and present. After meeting her, summer will never be the same again.
207479.storyline:
If you could travel through time, who’s the first person you’d meet?

When teenage boy Sia opens his eyes after making a wish on a boring summertime birthday, he finds himself in an unfamiliar time, in front of a familiar someone who he never had the chance to meet.

Together, she and Sia will form a bond through photography, while recapturing their lost time into rolls upon rolls of film.

Who is she, and what journey awaits this star-crossed duo?

Is a goodbye an ending, or a promise for a reunion?
Let’s find the answers together, across time and space, in Once Again.

214279.summary: Cuties Hacked is a new spin on the classic arcade formula of Xonix, that rewards your reflexes and skills with sets of beautifully crafted arts featuring some of the hottest girls you have ever seen.

216579.summary: A survival strategy RPG that combines exploration, tactical combat, and cooking mechanics to create the perfect dish of dungeon-crawling adventure! Customize the class, appearance, voice, and pose of your party members, then set off to find food in whatever way you can.
216579.storyline: When a group of adventurers plunge into the depths of an uncharted dungeon, they quickly realize they’ve bit off more than they can chew. Hopelessly lost, they must find whatever food they can while searching for a way out.

219179.summary: Join BIG C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

219779.summary: Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness puts your sanity to the test, challenging you to escape a labyrinth of nightmares and torment. Test your mind against a slow burn of puzzles, light survival mechanics, and methodical action.
219779.storyline: Experience the chilling story of a 1920s freak circus that burned to the ground, and the grotesque quest to found the circus anew. Follow the tormented Oliver Mills as he struggles to survive and escape.

220479.summary: Ralph needs your help to find all his toys especially his lovely little blue ball. Embark on a very charming hidden object game based on a true story.
220479.storyline: Ralph needs your help to find all his toys especially his lovely little blue ball. Embark on a very charming hidden object short game based on a true story.

222979.summary:
A new champion joins the game — the jack-of-all-trades Friedrich Diesel. His passion for engineering and everything connected with it has been fanatical since childhood, preferring machinery construction to communicating with people.

Diesel managed to learn the “Weird Science” ability and can create different mechanisms: a buggy, a helicopter, a spy camera, a protective wall. No laws of physics, and certainly not morality, can stop the genius of engineering on his way to victory.
222979.storyline: Friedrich was working on the development of his own brand-new micromotor, but during tests an explosion occurred that destroyed all the devices and the engineer disappeared... He appeared in a strange reality, where he was forced to accept the conditions of ritual survival games — F.O.A.D.

225779.summary:
R-Type Final 3 Evolved serves simultaneously as a sequel to R-Type Final 2, offering a whole new 7-stage campaign made in the engine of Final 2, whilst also serving as a compilation of most of content released for R-Type Final 2.

Additional features such as R-Park, an online area where one can interact with other players.

230779.summary: Race against your enemies in this harbour. Pay attention to your environment and win the race by forcing your enemy to get out of the track.

236479.summary: Ratopia is a new game that has combined elements of both strategic survival and city building. With plenty of content available, and more planned, enjoy a vast world to adventure and populate with citizens! Build your own economical system to sustain your ideal city of Ratopia.

239279.summary: Around 100 years since superpowers awakened in society, the Anti-Abnormal Unusual Talent Team (AUT) was created to prevent incidents caused by those wrongly using their powers. However, as these efforts became strained, the Reserve Anti-Unusual Talent Team (RAUT) was then formed to assist in tackling such conflict. This group is made up of the aforementioned students. Now, in 2023, the protagonist is a former member of the AUT who lost their powers after an unknown incident.

240179.summary: Feel the rhythm of her heart in a quick-thinking match game!

246079.summary: Raging Bytes is a story-driven zombie RPG full of drama and pixels! Survive the raging bytes! With difficulty levels for all kinds of players, dive into this post-apocalyptic world and face zombies in turn-based battles!
246079.storyline:
A police officer, Ben, awakens in hospital after an accident to find the city overrun by zombies!
What in the world is going on here? Can the government be relied on? Do any other survivors remain?
Ben stumbles upon a doctor named Barbra while struggling through zombie-infested streets.
Together, they make their way to Ben's police station, but only more horror awaits them.

250479.summary: Capture and harness powerful beasts to do combat and traverse the world in this monster taming action-adventure. Unravel the mystery of your existence by exploring a sinister island laboratory and putting an end to the creation of the Synth Beasts.

269079.summary: Experience Blade Dancer: Lineage of Light originally released on the PSP system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
269079.storyline: In a world protected by the gentle Prismatic Moon, an ancient evil is stirring. The Dread Knight has reappeared to wreak havoc across the land, and the Dark Lord gathers his strength. The world's only hope rests in the hands of Lance, a reluctant young adventurer. Discover your heritage and learn what it means to be the Protector of Light, Blade Dancer!

272779.summary: Broadsword: Warlord Edition is a turn-based tactical strategy game set to historical events of medieval conflict. Assemble your armies and put your tactics to the test, in Broadsword: Warlord Edition.

279879.summary: M.A.D. Cows is an exciting, retro, action platform game. Mow down aliens. Buy better guns. Rescue cows, dogs, raccoons, and more.

280479.summary: Touhou Spell Carnival is a strategy role-playing video game developed by Sting and published by Compile Heart.

283679.summary:
Jump into the pit and immerse yourself in a new chapter in the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe. Oswald wishes his town, and his life, weren’t so boring. That all changes when he explores the ball pit in a rundown pizzeria and finds himself in the past. However, Oswald’s deepest desire will have an unexpected cost…

Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it’s not just your own life that’s on the line. Oswald’s father and children from the past could all meet their end if you don’t save them.

288479.summary: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.
288479.storyline: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. They will face seven trials to complete the ticket that will take them to either Uptown or Undertown. There will be difficult and challenging moments, but together they can overcome any trial. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.

289379.summary: Fast-paced Rogue-like! Battle endless monsters, enjoy rapid Rogue-like thrills! Double the choices, unlock more classes, build unique talents! You are the hero!

293779.summary:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is a back story of the previous game The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge of all series. You are back in game as Youngho Choi, the main protagonist of The Coma 1, you must venture from the mirror dimension of reality to survive. What happened between The Coma 1 and The Coma 2? The answer is in here.

Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!
293779.storyline: Youngho’s second adventure begins. With only the hope of escaping from the Vicious Sister’s hands, Youngho collects the pages of Yaesol’s notes to find a powerful relic sword that can be used against the Vicious Sister. He never expected to find a huge facility beneath Dokaebi Market! Things get complicated when an unwanted invader comes to the mirror dimension, and a new character with ties to Yaesol appears to help Youngho. Will Youngho be able to defeat the Vicious Sister?

302379.summary: Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

306979.summary: Dead Rising returns with modern graphics! More than just a remaster, this Deluxe Remaster is a full graphical overhaul of the first game in zombie-slaughtering action game series "Dead Rising." This remaster has also been fully voiced, supports auto-saves, and has various other quality-of-life features. Witness the unmatched mayhem and freedom for yourself!

312279.summary: Kletka is a co-op horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

312979.summary: Old school action platformer game with pixel art graphics.
312979.storyline: Join the adventure as Yuhiko, a young ninja who has gone to the underworld to find a cure for his brother. Find Spirits in secret places – they will tell you a story or give you advice. Explore dungeons, fight monsters and meet new friends!

313179.summary: A remastered version of the No Rest for the Living made in the KEX Engine, community-published mod support, original midi soundtrack or the modern IDKFA version by Andrew Hulshult, improved performance with multithreaded rendering, BOOM source compatibility, accessibility options and translated into eight new languages.

316679.summary: Fight against thousands of zombies and evil creatures in this action roguelite. Collect cards, pets, characters and evolve them to become strong and not become zombie food.

316979.summary: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite first-person shooter set in deep space. Slay hordes of enemies, loot powerful gear, and customize your loadout during each unique run. Uncover fragments of your past as you piece together the truth behind your mission. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.

325279.summary: Plunge into the chaotic cybermyth roguelike world of Neon Abyss 2! With diverse combat styles and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic and action-packed experience you won't forget.

325779.summary: New puppy rescue mission from the evil bees!

327979.summary:
You don't need Mishelin Star to create the best restaurant in the world. Who says street food can't be delicious?

Start a real street food restaurant in your city and make it a legend. It's all for your beloved customers and let everyone visit you and find something tasty. Make this place trendy and watch your business grow!

Expand and upgrade your restaurant. Every guest will feel the fusion of the simple street food and amazing taste. Be a perfectionist and create something unique even in such a trivial place.

Manage the restaurant - add tables and new thematic spaces. Open new zones and add new dishes. Experiment with the menus and the ingredients. It's all up to you!

Let everyone taste and fall in love with your delicious street food!

328079.summary: The master of golf sims is back! Tee off with the world’s top golfers on the most storied courses on golf’s biggest stages.

329179.summary: The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in 8-bits! Battle through frantic platforming levels, defeat classic AVGN bosses, and save all of gaming from a corrupted monstrosity.

334879.summary: Seed of Nostalgia is a beautiful pixel art JRPG which follows the tale of Atilla and a cast of intriguing characters on a quest to save their dying world. Explore a mystical land, unravel dark secrets, and confront ancient forces in a tale of magic, sacrifice, and unexpected revelations.

335079.summary: Celebrate the special day with Remember St Patrick, a festive card-matching memory game perfect for all ages! Flip cards to reveal delightful St Patrick-themed icons like leprechauns, clovers, and rainbows, while testing your memory across increasing levels of fun and challenge. With cheerful visuals, cozy music, and endless holiday spirit, it’s the perfect way to make your gaming season merry and bright!

337279.summary: Animal Kingdom 3 is a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints and cameras while searching animals in fantastic locations! With 3 game modes and jigsaw and swap puzzles between the chapters, Animal Kingdom 3 will provide hours of fun for Hidden Object fans in soothing natural settings!

339979.summary: Aspire to reach the top of Crescent Tower that appears just once every 50 years! An authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawler RPG with a retro level of difficulty, where you repeatedly explore, level up, and traverse dungeons!

345579.summary: Venture into a vast 2D pixel-art fantasy world, face relentless battles and forge your destiny with vivid companions as you unravel the truth behind the falling crystals.
345579.storyline:
You'll play as Arven, a ranger who fights Shadows for a living among the ruins of Tellus. During his journey he will cross paths with Kat, a magical entity known as an Etheri, who merges with him, changing their destinies forever. Building your relationship as you adventure together will allow Arven to access new powers and discover secrets most humans can only imagine.

Fallen Fates takes place in a captivating world known as Tellus; whose lands are filled with many diverse biomes to explore. Each area has its own secrets to discover, monsters to slay, and a soundtrack full of unique music to bring them to life.

345679.summary: Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert," a difficult survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl.

347479.summary: Silly physics-based forklift game inspired by Ghibli and Japan car culture! Use your forklift skills in logic puzzles with many unexpected outcomes!

351079.summary: Only Up To Space is a casual yet heart-pounding climbing and platforming adventure that will test your skill, patience, and determination. As a stranded astronaut, you must ascend through a series of challenging, ever-ascending platforms to reach to the top after losing your shuttle. No wrong steps.

362279.summary: In this Action Roguelike, defend your farm from waves of enemies attacking with live vegetables. Dodge, catch, and use their own projectiles against them to survive. Uncover the conspiracy driving their revenge—a secret they don't even know themselves.

369179.summary:
Fast, sweet and full of energy: In "The Jumping Strawberry" you can expect a challenging endless game in which you jump and dodge through a world full of obstacles with an agile strawberry.

Jump your way through a fast-paced adventure that puts your reaction and precision to the test. Every platform counts - one wrong jump and the game starts all over again.

With lovingly drawn cartoon graphics and smooth controls, "The Jumping Strawberry" delivers fast-paced fun with real addictive potential.

371779.summary: In Viking Ventures, you awaken in a Viking hall suspended between life and death. There are no battles to fight—only conversations to unravel, keys to discover, and doors that may not lead where you expect. Explore shifting rooms, meet a cryptic bartender, and follow the pull of a quiet destiny in this short, atmospheric narrative adventure.

373279.summary: Welcome to Puzzle Blast — the ultimate sliding-puzzle challenge that blends relaxing seaside vibes with addictive brain-teasing gameplay. Whether you are a casual player looking to unwind or a puzzle master chasing the perfect solution, Puzzle Blast offers hours of satisfying fun.

375479.summary: Set in a historical fantasy theme against the backdrop of the ancient Silk Road in the Western China Regions, it tells the poignant love story of an exiled royal guard who returns to the ancient kingdom of Loulan in a turbulent era of warfare and seeks his beloved princess.
375479.storyline: You will control the skeletal warrior known as “The Cursed Sand" and navigate a Soul-like dangerous world from a top-down perspective, using sand manipulation abilities for exploration and puzzle-solving.

378179.summary: Leap into a world of calm precision and clever rhythm in this 2D platformer where every jump changes everything. You play as a brave ninja bunny in training, mastering the art of movement where each leap toggles platforms, spikes, and saws on or off. Timing isn’t just important, it’s everything.

386379.summary: Blast your way through swarms of robotic enemies in this fast-paced, retro-style sci-fi FPS!

387579.summary: River City Saga: Journey to the West is a roguelike action brawler that reimagines the classic Chinese novel with River City characters, casting Kunio as Sun Wukong and other familiar faces as legendary figures. In the turbulent Tang Dynasty, you embark on a pilgrimage to retrieve Buddhist scriptures, fighting through waves of demons and bosses with intuitive, satisfying combat. Every run features different layouts, enemies, and skills, encouraging repeated playthroughs as you grow stronger with each attempt.

387879.summary:
Your goal is to safely return to Earth by piloting the spacecraft and defeating the mysterious space organisms (blocks) that obstruct your path.

The ball can split into multiple pieces if it continues to bounce off the walls. Use various power-up items to your advantage and aim to clear all 33 rounds!

391279.summary:
‘Twas the night before Christmas—and something slimy is stirring.

You’re on the naughty list, and something green is coming for you. Something pickled! Run, hide, and survive the brined wrath of the Christmas Pickle—a festive slasher nightmare soaked in blood, and vinegar.

Deck the halls… with screams. Because this Christmas Dill be your last!

393179.summary: MOTE: The Old Office is a reflective walking simulator where you explore an abandoned startup space through the eyes of its CEO. Wander through meeting rooms, break areas, and forgotten corners as voice memories surface—stories of late nights, impossible deadlines, and the small moments that shaped everything. Along the way, collect 20 hidden donuts—a sweet reminder of the “night shift” days when sugar and panic powered the dream.
393179.storyline:
The office still smells faintly of burnt coffee and dry-erase ink.

You unlock the door like you’ve done a thousand times before, but this time no one’s inside. The desks are bare. The monitors are dark. The whiteboards still carry half-erased plans that once felt urgent enough to change the world. As you walk through the rooms, your own voice follows you — fragments of late-night promises, investor calls, pep talks you barely believed yourself.

Every corner remembers something. The conference room where you swore the team would make payroll. The break area where sugar and adrenaline stood in for sleep. The quiet desk by the window where someone once said, “We’re close. I can feel it.”

Hidden throughout the silence are twenty forgotten donuts — relics of the nights when panic tasted like frosting and ambition ran on caffeine. You collect them one by one, piecing together what this place used to be… and what it cost to build it.

Some dreams don’t crash. They just echo.

394979.summary: Furry Hearts is a cozy, school-set visual novel about finding your place—and the people who feel like home. You play as Kit, a fox who’s just moved to a new town, new house, and new class where he knows no one. Then come the firsts: a teammate who has your back (Lupus), a stage to help paint, a park that becomes “your spot,” and a girl whose smile you can’t stop sketching (Chloe). There’s a rival who runs too fast, an ex who scowls too hard, and a birthday that changes everything.

400379.summary: Run the league one decision at a time in EA Sports Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.

404379.summary:
"Cameltry" is an action game released by Taito in 1990.
Rotate the maze to roll the ball and reach the goal before the timer hits zero. A variety of obstacles stand in your way, including traps that reduce your time and bumpers that bounce the ball away. It's a unique ball-action game with a whole new sensation.
